scope: Phase four first batch: names, booleans, enumerations, integer/real values and object references
status: Implemented and behavior regressions passed; performance acceptance pending
implemented: Typed query/property/value-editor/command flow shared by built-ins and independent modules; public C interface version 10 contains no STL, SDK, SDL or ImGui dependency.
EditorApplication owns inline drafts and copied type/choice metadata; renderers update a typed value sink and submit once on accept or deactivation.
Native parameter dialogs retain owned working copies and their selected editor, modifier and lazy choice provider; all rows commit in one Edit or roll back together.
ParameterValues owns basic native type resolution, finite and range checks, conversion and undo data records with complete target and referenced-object identities.
Attribute values, native ParameterBox, debugger basic values, Schematic names and simple parameter values use the common path. Existing complex and specialized editors remain available.
Schematic name/type/link/value editing is grouped once; a disconnected shared input does not modify its former shared value.
Unchanged acceptance and cancellation preserve Redo. Busy/stale targets, same-ID reuse and type changes cannot redirect a draft.
Delegating commands reuse the enclosing operation ID; 300 successive native edits do not exhaust the pending-operation window.
